offerings.name: Search (LLM Context / Web search)
offerings.pricing: $5.00 per 1,000 requests (Prepaid — buy credits upfront and draw them down as you use the API)
offerings.free_quota: Includes $5 in free credits every month. Credits are automatically applied to your account.
offerings.output_type: JSON 搜索结果（URLs、text snippets、news、images、videos 等），LLM Context 端点返回 grounding 上下文 + sources 映射
offerings.note: 容量 50 requests per second；支持 Goggles 自定义重排与过滤、最多 5 条 extra snippets、schema-enriched results；索引 40+ billion pages

offerings.name: Answers
offerings.pricing: $4.00 per 1,000 queries + $5.00 per 1,000,000 input tokens + $5.00 per 1,000,000 output tokens (Prepaid)
offerings.price_basis: Prepaid Answers plan, 每 1,000 queries 的基础费用（不含 token 计费）
offerings.free_quota: Includes $5 in free credits every month. Credits are automatically applied to your account.
offerings.output_type: LLM 生成的完整答案（OpenAI SDK 兼容的 chat/completions 接口，支持 streaming），基于单次或多次搜索 grounding
offerings.note: 容量 2 requests per second；Grounding supported by citations；token 另按 $5/百万输入与 $5/百万输出计费

offerings.name: Spellcheck
offerings.price_basis: Prepaid Spellcheck plan, per 1,000 requests 换算
offerings.free_quota: Includes free $5 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: 拼写纠错结果（附 enriched autosuggest）
offerings.note: 容量 100 requests per second；属搜索辅助端点

offerings.name: Autosuggest
offerings.price_basis: Prepaid Autosuggest plan, per 1,000 requests 换算
offerings.free_quota: Includes free $5 in credits every month.
offerings.note: 容量 100 requests per second；含 spellcheck 与 enriched autosuggest
